Primary request: Ut Sen, an original cheerful human Vietnamese woman running a Mekong floating-market boat restaurant. Front-facing full body, slightly elevated top-down three-quarter camera. Tan skin, big expressive dark eyes, scruffy black hair and a small bun under a cream conical non la hat, turquoise ao ba ba blouse, red-and-cream checkered khan ran scarf, short worn ivory apron over dark plum trousers, simple sandals. Small charming grime details. Hands empty, alert friendly pose.
